line: Double cup me, Pimp C, pockets they on Bun B (Bun B)
vault_lines: Double cup me, Pimp C, pockets they on Bun B (Bun B)
meaning:
This line refers to the American rap duo UGK, short for Underground Kingz. UGK consists of the two rappers Pimp C and Bun B. Double cups refers to having two cups, usually styrofoam but also solo cups, filled with lean.



The rapper Pimp C was the first one to start this trend. In an interview with Sway Calloway, rapper Lil Wayne explained why he had double cups filled with lean:

“I did it cuz Pimp C did it, flat out.”

When Takeoff says that he has pockets on Bun B, he refers to the 1992 UGK song, “Pocket Full of Stones”. Having pockets full of stones means having drugs or money in your pocket.
